content.text: I'll split this into separate `lint` and `test` jobs, each with their own checkout/setup steps.

input.old_string:
jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v8.3.2
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked

      - name: Lint (ruff)
        run: uv run ruff check .

      - name: Test (pytest)
        run: uv run pytest -q
        env:
          NO_COLOR: "1"
input.new_string:
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v8.3.2
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked

      - name: Lint (ruff)
        run: uv run ruff check .

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v8.3.2
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked

      - name: Test (pytest)
        run: uv run pytest -q
        env:
          NO_COLOR: "1"
